reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and I don't buy something just because a TikTok video made it look good. Nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium, so I have no reason to start.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And no doctor has said I need it, so it feels like another bottle I'll quit using after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me my magnesium is low and recommending bisglycinate specifically.
